name: cajeerengine
product_changes: 2.0.5 Backup & Rollback Integration: authenticated backup/rollback preflight with database recovery readiness, storage requirements and disk headroom, duplicate snapshot verification before live code replacement, exact-transaction browser-approved rollback and full backup through the dedicated operator, fail-closed queue and recovery markers, administrative backup/rollback controls in Nuxt and static SPA, and runnable SQLite fault-injection regression. Restoring an existing committed update discards subsequent writes; real staging acceptance remains required.

2.0.4 Admin Update Center: production static SPA and Nuxt update management, read-only diagnostics, explicit check, browser-approved durable download+stage and install queues executed by dedicated non-root operator, 5-second status polling, bounded request history, server-side selected release validation, CSRF/RBAC/recent reauthentication, and fail-closed recovery behavior. Manual rollback remains until 2.0.5; live staging verification required.

2.0.3 Update Execution Service: dedicated non-root, systemd-timer-driven one-shot operator consumes one browser-confirmed staged apply request at a time, reuses the existing transactional signed update/backup/recovery path, locks concurrent workers, records operator status, rejects malformed requests and fails closed on interrupted journals; backup and rollback approvals remain manual. Live deployment validation required.

2.0.2 Secure Release Downloader: operator CLI update:download fetches only canonical CajeerTeam GitHub Release production dist ZIP and its checksum/signature; bounded streamed HTTPS download through pinned public DNS and allowlisted redirects, strict SHA256 and Ed25519 verification with externally provisioned trust key, full release ZIP manifest verification, atomic verified local publication, idempotent integrity checked cache, rollback-safe cleanup. No automatic installation; no database migrations.

2.0.1 Automatic Release Discovery: periodic six-hour GitHub Releases checks in the production scheduler, conditional ETag requests, bounded rate-limit cooldown, durable metadata cache and last-check status, read-only admin diagnostics and failure-visible scheduler state. No automatic download or installation; no DB migrations.

2.0.0 Production Release: repair the real source/dist artifact publication boundary to prevent incomplete release indexes, and redact operator support bundles by excluding raw audit/runtime events and environment values; enforce restricted support artifact permissions and bounded operational summaries. Maintains existing CMS, External Analytics, Migration Center, SkiF4er ID and AI Assistant code; live production GA admission requires signed dist and full CI/staging evidence.

1.9.9 Production GA Qualification: decrypt offsite recovery archives into an isolated workspace and publish only after the authenticated final frame, rejecting partial/corrupt inputs without modifying the destination; prevent certification of distributions missing runtime files present in source, and require matching release stability metadata. Exercise negative acceptance and build gates in PR/release CI. Full production-host, dependency and soak acceptance still required before 2.0 RC.

1.9.8 Full Platform E2E & Recovery: fail closed on SQLite foreign key violations even when integrity_check succeeds (PDO and Python recovery paths), verify restored SQLite byte-for-byte against the authenticated snapshot after recovery, and enforce complete isolated CMS, identity, analytics, migration, queue, AI and disaster-recovery acceptance from the release CI. Real production host and external services still require separate acceptance.

1.9.7 Compatibility & Upgrade: unify strict Engine API and extension dependency range validation (caret, tilde, comparisons and zero-major boundaries); verify installed enabled extension manifests against signed target Engine API before destructive upgrade; reject spoofed stable/RC release catalogs and invalid extension constraints; fix native Node ESM SDK import of generated operations and validate HTTPS-only remote endpoints; execute regression suite in PR and release CI. Source/SDK API operations remain backward compatible.

1.9.6 Performance & Scalability: aggregate CMS search result-count/type/locale facets in one MVCC SQL scan; consolidate bounded RAG retrieval of up to 14 terms into one indexed SQL round trip while keeping separate per-term caps and publication checks; skip stampede locks for previously identified oversized public pages via short-lived invalidating markers; batch queue-worker observability metrics to reduce lock contention without losing completed batch totals. Include actual SQLite query and regression coverage in CI; staging throughput and p95/p99 remain external acceptance gates.

1.9.5 Security & Privacy Hardening: make 2FA recovery-code redemption atomic on PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite; prevent login enumeration with uniform failures, dummy Argon2id verification and hashed audit identifiers; bound login and JSON request sizes; redact production validation/database/extension failures; restrict runtime log permissions and refuse symlink redirection; suppress credentials in PHP stack traces via SensitiveParameter. Dedicated runtime and PDO integration acceptance are mandatory; live penetration testing remains separate.

1.9.4 AI Assistant Production: validate real OpenAI SSE completion, stream accounting, output caps and tool-batch safety before executing CMS tools; block JSON-encoded credentials in AI tool outputs, wipe decrypted API keys on preflight failure, and verify complete AI Automation schema in live readiness. Offline protocol/fault regressions are mandatory; billable provider and production-host acceptance still require operator opt-in.

1.9.3 SkiF4er ID Production: remove obsolete 1.6.0 live acceptance gate, verify current installed release and pinned live Keycloak signing keys, reject ID/access token substitution and unbound introspection results, and enforce functional SSO protocol regressions. Live Keycloak E2E still requires staging credentials and deployment.

1.9.2 Migration Center Production: enforce target revision compare-and-swap for every content and incremental sync update, refusing stale editor revisions even in checkpointed batches; reject truncated WordPress metadata and category relationships; honor Rank Math noindex from serialized metadata without deserialization; add real-path regression and production operator acceptance procedures. Full target staging/CI certification remains required.

1.9.1 RC Acceptance Closure & External Analytics Production: repaired stable operational acceptance version gate, blocked inconsistent release channel/stability metadata, fixed Google Search Console PUT sitemap submission, invalidated report snapshots on any credential rotation, and added live-schema/transport and recovery regressions. External provider staging verification and signed dist acceptance are required before GA certification.

Release Candidate 1.9.0-rc.1: isolate candidate updates from the stable channel, verify exact application payload parity across source and dist, bind certification evidence to real payload metadata and enforce candidate publication semantics. Production acceptance requires passing every required CI and staging deployment gate on the same release bytes.

Release Candidate Qualification 1.8.9: enforce payload-accurate release certification including ZIP inventory and sidecar checks, fail closed on tampered archives, validate reproducibility and prerelease SemVer, and run qualification regressions in CI.

Documentation & Operational Readiness 1.8.8: comprehensive deployment, operations, security, incident and recovery runbooks with an executable documentation contract verifier in CI; corrected runtime environment examples and release versions.

Deployment & Recovery Acceptance 1.8.7: durable one-time operator requests (running/completed/failed) to prevent replay after abrupt failure; offline local signed-package planning; bounded database/validator subprocesses with original error context preserved; verified database and encrypted-environment restoration before a restore journal is cleared; real SQLite encrypted backup and recovery acceptance added to PR/release CI.

End-to-End Regression 1.8.6: eliminate lost file-backed CMS preview tokens with an inter-process lock and TTL pruning; expire tokens before usage writes; exercise full CMS draft/preview/publication/search/static export lifecycle and 16 concurrent preview writers, and make real HTTP middleware, migrated SQLite, queue, media, import/export and AI acceptance a mandatory CI gate.

Performance & Load Testing 1.8.5: remove public search publication-row shared locks by using repeatable-read MVCC snapshots; serialize concurrent public render cache misses per path without hiding render errors; reduce PostgreSQL queue lease-recovery round trips during active work while preserving forced idle recovery; ship concurrent PHP and HTTPS staging load acceptance with measurable RPS/latency/error gates.

Database & Compatibility 1.8.4: execute immutable MySQL migrations on both MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 10.11 by translating unsupported ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS into column-existence checks; split SQL scripts for portable PDO execution; reject mismatched migration dialects; detect missing and modified applied migrations; verify full PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite migrations in isolated CI databases.

Runtime & Queue Resilience 1.8.4: isolate scheduler tasks after queue/backend failures, preserve completed effects on uncertain acknowledgement, surface transport outages as HTTP 503 and CLI failures, redact scheduler errors, and execute fault-injection regressions.

Security Hardening 1.8.2: owner-constrained API token revocation; strict token issuance validation; HTTPS-only webhook destinations with signing secret rotation on receiver change; no webhook signing secrets in list/update or receiver responses in logs; production error redaction and database diagnostic privacy; executable security regressions.

Identity SkiF4er ID GA 1.6.0: atomic SSO unlink and session revocation, callback registry validation, serializable subject-mapping login, bounded signed token assertions, resilient real admin session UX and integration acceptance.
AI Assistant ChatGPT 1.6.1: encrypted OpenAI configuration, live Responses API SSE streaming, durable per-user conversations, monthly budget reservation and recovery, Nuxt and static SPA UI.
AI Content Editor 1.6.2: live generation and rewriting of title/text/richtext/block fields, durable per-user proposals, token budget reservations, revision CAS acceptance, and both admin interfaces.

AI CMS Diagnostics 1.6.5: real OperationsMonitor/SecurityHardener probes, redacted runtime event aggregation, actionable read-only rules, optional budgeted OpenAI explanation, Nuxt and production static SPA.

AI Knowledge Base 1.6.6: authenticated category/document workflows, TXT/Markdown/PDF import, published CMS entry sync, separate private full-text inverted index, optimistic revisions and dual admin interfaces.

AI Knowledge Chat / RAG 1.6.7: owner-scoped indexed retrieval, published/current CMS source guards, referenced OpenAI answers, feedback, audit and protected conversation histories in both admin interfaces.

AI Support Center 1.6.8: public guest widget with per-ticket capability tokens, operator ticket queue, assignments, replies, handoff, and public-only RAG suggestions, live DB acceptance and dual admin UI.

AI Security & Acceptance 1.6.9: outbound credential rejection before OpenAI HTTP, durable token budget and existing permissions, race-safe idempotent support replies, opt-in bounded privacy retention with rollback, real PDO acceptance and offline secret-boundary regression.
AI Assistant ChatGPT GA 1.7.2: read-only live deployment acceptance, optional OpenAI provider probe, concurrent ticket and RAG protection, and complete CI AI regression gates.

AI External Analytics 1.7.3: evidence-based per-provider comparisons and seven-day changes on persisted reports, credential-free AI explanations with shared monthly budget, read-only CMS tool, dual admin interfaces and release regressions.

AI SEO & Content Insights 1.7.4: exact CMS URL matching against saved page-level analytics, conservative period comparisons, prioritized SEO audits and revision-confirmed proposals in Nuxt and static SPA.

AI Migration Copilot 1.7.5: read-only post-import DLE/WordPress audit from saved reconciliation and bounded live target redirects/media/route checks, prioritized operator guidance, credential-free AI explanation, Nuxt and SPA.

AI Migration Remediation 1.7.6: operator-approved one-time 301 redirect restoration from verified saved migration evidence and public route index repair, revalidation, transactional rollback, strict project/user ownership, Nuxt and static SPA.

AI Automation Security & Acceptance 1.7.9: serialized per-owner quota locks, queue dead-letter reconciliation, fair retry offers, stale-run timeout, redacted worker exceptions, 30-day prompt cleanup, live acceptance tests.

AI Automation GA 1.8.0: standalone (still disabled) RabbitMQ deterministic IDs/one-attempt policy, fail-safe queue scans, operator kill switch, immediate soft-delete prompt redaction, bounded retention and backlog metrics, regression checks.

Release Baseline & CI Stabilization 1.8.1: synchronized runtime/admin/SDK versions, restored missing AI Automation OpenAPI endpoints and SDK operations, real PHP syntax gates, complete PHPUnit/analysis gates, and verified release artifacts.
